subject: Re: MAP kickoff — risk clearance, SIG/CAIQ and data-retention schedule
messages:
From: Anna Bright <anna.bright@finspire.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: security@finspire.com, james.park@procureco.com
Date: 2026-07-12T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff — security checklist and data-retention windows

Marcus,

Thanks for the quick call earlier. As discussed, Finspire needs a short, actionable MAP that ties the evaluation milestones to explicit security gates so our procurement team can sign off. High-level asks from our side:

- Proof of SOC 2 Type II or equivalent evidence (summary + report)
- Completed SIG/CAIQ matrix populated against your hosted product
- Draft DPA language that includes a clear data-retention schedule and deletion processes for both test and production data
- Confirmation of where logs/audit trails are retained and for how long (and whether we can configure retention)

Can you propose a 3-week cadence that maps each of these gates to a specific date owner? We prefer minimal overlap with our internal audit week (week of 2026-07-26).

I've attached the baseline SIG questionnaire our procurement team will use — please fill what you can and flag anything you need more detail on.

Best,
Anna Bright
CISO, Finspire

Attachments: Finspire-SIG-Questionnaire-v1.xlsx (xlsx)
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Anna Bright <anna.bright@finspire.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security checklist and data-retention windows

Anna — thanks for the clear list. Draft MAP below with owners and dates; I kept the schedule tight to avoid blocking your audit week. Irene (Security) and Kimberly (Contracts) are looped to confirm evidence availability and DPA redline timing.

Proposed MAP (3-week closure runway)
Week 1 (2026-07-12 to 2026-07-18):
- Redwood provides SOC 2 Type II summary and control map (Owner: marcus_lin) — deliver by 2026-07-15
- Redwood fills initial SIG/CAIQ responses and highlights any ambiguous items (Owner: irene_choi) — deliver by 2026-07-16

Week 2 (2026-07-19 to 2026-07-25):
- Finspire review of SIG/CAIQ and quick clarifying questions (Owner: Anna) — target 2026-07-22
- Legal redline round 1 on DPA (data-retention section emphasized) (Owner: kimberly_park) — draft to Finspire by 2026-07-23

Week 3 (2026-07-26 to 2026-08-01):
- Finalize DPA retention window and sign-off on audit evidence (Owner: both legal teams) — target 2026-07-30
- Prep cutover notes for production/qa data deletion processes (Owner: irene_choi) — target 2026-07-30

Notes/Constraints:
- SOC 2 report is available but the full report contains vendor redactions; we will provide an unredacted copy to your security mailbox under an NDA if needed.
- Our default retention windows: logs (90 days), audit trails (365 days), customer-managed dataset retention = configurable between 30–365 days (we can lock to a specific SLA for contracts)
- DPA template includes standard 90/365 defaults but we can accommodate a shorter retention for test environments and include a contractual obligation for data deletion on termination.

Does this align with your deadlines? If so, I will attach the SOC 2 summary and the initial SIG draft to this thread and Kimberly will circulate a DPA draft.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments (to follow): SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2025.pdf (pdf), Redwood-SIG-Responses-draft.xlsx (xlsx)
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: Anna Bright <anna.bright@finspire.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-12T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — follow-up on SIG + retention details

Anna,Marcus — quick technical clarification from security. A few items we flagged while populating the SIG that affect the acceptance gate:

1) Key management: we use customer KMS integration for encryption-at-rest in Private deployments; for Hosted customers we can offer a customer-managed key via our KMS integration (requires an onboarding step). Please confirm whether Finspire requires CMK or is okay with Redwood-managed keys for the initial POC.

2) Data segregation: for Dedicated/Hosted we offer tenant isolation and logical separation; if your compliance needs physical isolation we should flag early as that affects timelines and costs.

3) Audit logs: we can provide an audit log export and retain for 365 days by default. We can configure retention to 180 or 90 days on request and document deletion APIs for customers to purge PII from test instances.

Proposed acceptance criteria for the security gate:
- SOC 2 summary + auditor statement received
- SIG responses completed with any open items triaged and assigned
- DPA data-retention clause includes explicit retention windows for logs, backups, and customer datasets and a deletion API path

I'll attach the SIG workbook with inline comments. If Finspire needs an unredacted SOC 2, we will request an NDA and provide it to security@finspire.com.

Irene Choi
Staff Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood-SIG-Responses-draft.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Anna Bright <anna.bright@finspire.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: security@finspire.com, james.park@procureco.com, irene_choi@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-13T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — confirm MAP and next steps

Thanks — this looks good and realistic. A few quick decisions from our side:

- Finspire will accept a hosted deployment with Redwood-managed keys for the initial POC. If we move to Dedicated or Private later we will re-evaluate CMK.
- We need shorter retention for test datasets: please set a contractual 30-day retention for any test/qa buckets (production retention can remain at your default configurable window).
- We will sign a limited NDA to receive the unredacted SOC 2 report; can you send the NDA link and the SOC 2 summary today?

Next steps (Agreed):
1) Marcus — send SOC 2 summary and NDA link by EOD 2026-07-13
2) Irene — finalize SIG workbook with comments and mark any open items by 2026-07-16
3) Kimberly — circulate DPA draft (with test-data 30-day retention clause) by 2026-07-16

Appreciate the speedy turnaround. If we can get the SOC 2 summary and DPA draft this week we'll slot the procurement review for week of 2026-07-19.

Anna 
CISO, Finspire
